name: Bad Parents
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred responsibility of parents to honor God by faithfully training their children in His ways, as seen in Proverbs 22:6 and Exodus 20:12. Failure to nurture and care for one's family leads to ruin, illustrated in Proverbs 11:29, while God Himself provides comfort and remembrance even when earthly parents forsake their children, as affirmed in Psalms 27:10 and Isaiah 49:15. Ultimately, each person bears accountability for their own sin, underscoring the importance of righteous parenting without passing iniquity between generations, as taught in Ezekiel 18:20.
